metadata.question: Did Wilmington, North Carolina receive at least 90 inches of rainfall during the year of 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Wilmington, North Carolina (approximately 34.2257° N, 77.9447° W) - Date: Entire year 2018 (2018-01-01 to 2018-12-31) - Collection: GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) or CHIRPS for precipitation data - GPM IMERG Final Run is good for daily precipitation at ~11km resolution 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for precipitation products - Question is about total rainfall, not cloud cover 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid Zero: If there truly was minimal rainfall (unlikely for a full year in NC) - A (Yes): Total >= 90 inches (2286 mm) - B (No): Total < 90 inches but valid calculation - C1: No images in collection for 2018 - C2: No valid pixels after processing (unlikely for precip data) - C3: Result is None/NaN or invalid (negative precipitation) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define location and time period const wilmington = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.9447, 34.2257]); const startDate = '2018-01-01'; const endDate = '2018-12-31'; // 2. Load GPM precipitation data let precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(wilmington) .select('precipitation'); const colSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`GPM Images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { // Try CHIRPS as backup precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(wilmington) .select('precipitation'); const chirpsSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS Images found: ${chirpsSize}`); if (chirpsSize === 0) { console.log('No precipitation data available for 2018'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Sum all precipitation over the year const totalPrecip = precipCol.sum(); // 4. Calculate total precipitation at Wilmington const result = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: wilmington, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const precipMm = result.get('precipitation').getInfo(); // 5. Check for valid data if (precipMm === null || precipMm === undefined || isNaN(precipMm)) { console.log('Calculation failed - no valid result'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (precipMm < 0) { console.log(`Invalid precipitation value: ${precipMm} mm`); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) const precipInches = precipMm / 25.4; console.log(`Total precipitation in 2018: ${precipMm.toFixed(2)} mm (${precipInches.toFixed(2)} inches)`); // 6. Determine answer if (precipInches >= 90) { console.log(`Wilmington received ${precipInches.toFixed(2)} inches, which is >= 90 inches`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`Wilmington received ${precipInches.toFixed(2)} inches, which is < 90 inches`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
